name: Vek'zol
summary: Zevrost asks you to use a Sin'dorei tome at the Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands. He wants Vek'zol's heart as a reagent for greater power.

sections.title: Zevrost's Request
sections.body: Zevrost studies diagrams in the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning, though he cannot read Thalassian. He believes the blood elves meant to summon demons and drain their fel magic. He sees a greater use for that power. You are to perform the ritual at the Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands and bring Vek'zol's heart to him in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Who is asking me to summon Vek'zol?
faq.answer: Zevrost asks you to summon Vek'zol and bring its heart to him in Orgrimmar.
The ritual is to be performed at the Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands.

faq.q: Why does Zevrost want Vek'zol's heart?
faq.answer: Zevrost says Vek'zol's heart will make a potent reagent.

faq.q: What is in the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning?
faq.answer: It contains diagrams Zevrost recognizes, though he does not speak Thalassian. He believes they describe summoning demons to drain their fel magic.

faq.q: Where do I bring the heart?
faq.answer: Bring Vek'zol's heart to Zevrost in Orgrimmar.
